The leaders

in cosmetic, reconstructive, and implant dentistry

If you’re dealing with discomfort, uncertainty, or dental work that keeps failing, you’re not alone — and you’re not out of options. At Vivid Specialized Dentistry, our highly trained specialists bring advanced expertise and a collaborative approach to every case. We take the time to diagnose the true cause of the problem, explain your options clearly, and rebuild your smile with precision and care. This is where complex dentistry gets a clear plan — and where patients finally feel confident moving forward.

Dr. Arif Sumar

BSc, DMD, FRCDC

Board-Certified Prosthodontist | Dental Implant Specialist | Complex Case Specialist

Dr. Arif Sumar is a Canadian Board-Certified Specialist in Prosthodontics with over 14 years of experience in advanced restorative and implant dentistry. Over the course of his career, he has treated more than 7,500 patients and restored over 5,000 dental implants, earning recognition as one of Alberta’s leading dental implant specialists.

He is frequently consulted for complex cases — including trauma, congenital conditions, and failed dental work — where precision, planning, and interdisciplinary collaboration are critical. Working closely with surgical and periodontal specialists, Dr. Sumar redesigns treatment with a focus on long-term success, helping patients achieve outcomes that are both functional and enduring.

That depth of experience allows him to anticipate complications before they arise, prevent failures, and design treatment that works the first time.

Areas of Focus

  • Dental Implants
  • Full Mouth Reconstruction
  • Cosmetic Dentistry
  • Crowns And Bridges
  • Veneers
  • Dentures
  • Complex Restorative Cases
  • Implant-Supported Prosthetics

Dr. Sumar’s approach to care

Dr. Sumar’s approach is rooted in a comprehensive understanding of how form, function, and aesthetics work together. As a prosthodontist, he looks beyond individual teeth to evaluate the full relationship between the smile, facial structure, and overall oral health.

At Vivid Specialized Dentistry, this philosophy is supported by a fully integrated model of care. With access to top-tier digital technology and an in-house precision dental lab, Dr. Sumar and his team are able to maintain complete control over quality, streamline communication, and refine every detail of the final result.

A practice built for complex care

Dr. Sumar’s practice is designed around delivering an all-inclusive treatment experience for patients who require a higher level of expertise. From advanced diagnostics to final restoration, every step happens within a coordinated, multidisciplinary environment.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Pharmacology, University of Alberta
  • Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD) McGill University
  • Certificate of Advanced Study in Prosthodontics, University of Pittsburgh

Advanced Training & Leadership

  • Clinical Instructor, University of Alberta Implant Clinic (2013–2025)
  • Fellow, Royal College of Dentists of Canada (FRCDC)

Professional Affiliations

  • Royal College of Dentists of Canada (RCDC)
  • Alberta Dental Association
  • College of Dental Surgeons of Alberta
  • Alberta Academy of Prosthodontists
  • Alberta Society of Dental Specialists

Beyond the Practice

Dr. Sumar maintains a strong commitment to continued learning, teaching, and innovation in the field of prosthodontics. His work as a clinical instructor and his ongoing engagement with evolving dental technologies reflect a philosophy that great outcomes come from continuously refining both skill and knowledge.

Dr. Nazia Abrol

BDS, MDS, MSc

Periodontist | Surgical Foundations Specialist | Implant-Supportive Care

Dr. Nazia Abrol is a periodontist whose work strengthens the foundation beneath every lasting smile. She specializes in diagnosing and treating gum disease and performs advanced implant-supportive procedures, including bone grafting and guided tissue regeneration, critical steps when long-term stability is the goal. Patients often see Dr. Abrol as part of implant planning or complex restorative care.

With a Master of Science in Periodontology from the University of Alberta and advanced postgraduate credentials (BDS, MDS), Dr. Abrol is known for her calm, precise approach and clear explanations. Her role is essential: when implants and restorations are expected to last, periodontal health and surgical accuracy aren’t optional, they’re the starting point.

Areas Of Focus

  • Periodontal Disease Treatment
  • Bone Grafting
  • Guided Tissue Regeneration
  • Implant-Supportive Care
  • Surgical Periodontal Therapy
  • Complex Restorative Support
  • Foundational Treatment Planning
  • Long-Term Tissue And Bone Stability

Dr. Abrol’s approach to care

Dr. Abrol brings a thoughtful, detail-oriented approach to every case. As a periodontist, she understands that successful dentistry depends on more than what is visible above the gumline. Her work focuses on creating and preserving the healthy bone and gum support that every strong, lasting smile depends on.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS)
  • Master of Dental Surgery (MDS)
  • Master of Science (MSc) in Periodontology, University of Alberta
  • Registered Dentist, Alberta Dental Association

Professional Affiliations

  • Alberta Dental Association
  • College of Dental Surgeons of Alberta
  • Alberta Society of Dental Specialists

Dr. Mo Omar

BDS, PhD

Periodontist | Dental Implant Specialist | Soft Tissue & Grafting Specialist

Dr. Mo Omar is a periodontist whose 10,000-kilometre journey from Cairo to Edmonton was driven by a passion for preserving teeth and creating healthy, aesthetic smiles. His work centers on periodontics — the specialty focused on the gums, bone, and foundation that every lasting smile depends on.

After completing three years of specialty training, he spent another three years researching the genetic link between gum disease and heart disease, becoming the first PhD graduate in Periodontology at the University of Alberta. He also completed postgraduate training in Oral Cancer at the University of Dundee in Scotland.

Areas Of Focus

  • Surgical Periodontal Care
  • Non-Surgical Periodontal Care
  • Dental Implants
  • Soft Tissue Grafting
  • Natural Tooth Preservation
  • Gum Disease Treatment

Dr. Omar's approach to care

Dr. Omar is committed to helping patients keep their natural teeth whenever possible through surgical and non-surgical periodontal care, dental implants, and soft tissue grafting. He believes every patient should understand their treatment, so education is part of every visit.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS)
  • PhD in Periodontology, University of Alberta (first PhD graduate in the program)
  • Specialty Training in Periodontics
  • Postgraduate Training in Oral Cancer, University of Dundee, Scotland

Beyond the Practice

Outside the clinic, you’ll likely find Dr. Omar at the gym, in a yoga class, at the dog park, or cheering on his daughter, Laila, at gymnastics competitions alongside his wife, Sara.

Dr. Alisha Amlani

BDS, CAGS

Prosthodontist | Complex Restorative & Cosmetic Specialist | Clinical Educator

Dr. Alisha Amlani brings together academic insight and clinical expertise. She completed her advanced specialty training in prosthodontics at Boston University in 2024, developing high-level skills in intricate restorative and cosmetic care. Today, she holds a faculty position at the University of Alberta’s Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry, teaching the next generation of dental professionals and staying at the forefront of modern dental education.

At Vivid Specialized Dentistry, Dr. Amlani applies that background to complex prosthodontic cases. Her work restores oral health, function, and aesthetics through full-mouth reconstruction, dental implants, crowns, bridges, and advanced cosmetic procedures.

Areas Of Focus

  • Full Mouth Reconstruction
  • Dental Implants
  • Crowns And Bridges
  • Cosmetic Dentistry
  • Complex Prosthodontic Cases
  • Implant-Supported Prosthetics
  • Advanced Restorative Care

Dr. Amlani’s approach to care

Dr. Amlani bridges the gap between university-level research and private practice. She plans each case with evidence behind every decision, weighing how bite, tissue health, and aesthetics work together before any treatment begins. The result is care that is precise, personalized, and built to last.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS), Plymouth University, UK
  • Certificate of Advanced Graduate Study (CAGS) in Prosthodontics, Boston University

Advanced Training & Leadership

  • Advanced Specialty Training in Prosthodontics, Boston University (2024)
  • Faculty Member, University of Alberta Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry
